title: Boundary wall maximum height, R10-R40 (3.5 m)
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, maximum boundary wall height: R10 - R17.5 3.5m; R20 - R25 3.5m; R30 - R40 3.5m (both rows).

exceptions.label: abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension (C3.4.5)

replaces.note: R10-R17.5 had no standalone boundary wall provision (C4P1-092)

verified.note: Table 4A (p7) prints '3.5m (1 storey)' spanning R10 to R40.

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#height-r10-r40. Table 3.4c (p34) values unchanged from Chapter 3; the clause text now cites C3.8.1 for overshadowing. 3.5 m for every band R10-R40 (C4P1-092 to C4P1-094; Table 4A p7 '3.5m (1 storey)'). Height includes any retaining wall directly beneath (Figure 3.4k). Lower density code governs between differently coded sites (C3.4.4#r1).
